prompt: A vertical snapshot from the pavement through the open glass door of a small British corner shop at night, shot on cheap 35mm colour film, grainy, soft, underexposed, cold teal cast with overblown fluorescent tubes. Hand-printed paper sign taped to the door glass reads "BREAD £50". Inside: a wire spinner rack, a lit fridge, a wall fan, and at the far end the stockroom door wide open, a cold blue light pulsing from inside it. On the dirty doormat a small unbranded purple chocolate bar has fallen, its sticker reading "£12". The shop is empty yet feels occupied. Thanks.
